title: Emergency management’s AI challenge isn’t technology — it’s implementation, new reports say
summary: New reports from the nonprofit Markle Foundation's AI for Disasters and Emergencies Initiative found that AI holds great benefit for emergency management agencies, if they can clear hurdles of governance, procurement and skills shortages.

title: NTIA plans to restore some Digital Equity Act funding after court battle over Trump cancellation
summary: The National Telecommunications and Information Administration said it plans to restore some of the funding that had been revoked, after a court ruled that Trump administration couldn't outright terminate the Digital Equity Act.

title: NSF announces $100M grant program for state, regional AI infrastructure hubs
summary: The National Science Foundation said a new program will provide funding for research, education and workforce development in AI.

title: Pennsylvania data tool allows parents to view school-level vaccination rates
summary: A new online tool allows Pennsylvania parents and policymakers to view vaccination rates by school for the 2025-2026 school year.

title: How do California’s gubernatorial candidates stack up on AI & tech policy?
summary: For state and local IT leaders, the outcome of the November election could shape everything from AI procurement rules and cybersecurity investments to digital service modernization and workforce priorities.

title: Governors association partners on $1M AI workforce project
summary: The National Governors Association has joined with RAISE US, a nonprofit workforce initiative, to assist states in developing effective policies to reskill the workforce around AI technologies.

title: Justice Department partners with six states to combat public benefits fraud
summary: Through new channels of timely information, Alabama, Florida, Georgia, Louisiana, Mississippi, North Carolina and South Carolina hope to identify fraud earlier and coordinate prosecutions across state and federal jurisdictions.

title: Civil rights groups back federal suit against NYPD’s ‘Suspect DNA Index’
summary: The Legal Aid Society's case argues that New York City's "rogue" DNA database violates state law and civil rights.

title: ‘Tech for good’ — How better digital services can improve state childcare programs
summary: In an interview, Jenna Bannon with the  National Conference of State Legislatures said tools built for people in need must "work for them."

title: K-12 cyber information exchange, incident catalog would be directed by CISA under new legislative proposal
summary: The Enhancing K-12 Cybersecurity Act failed to pass in 2023. Sens. Mark Warner and Marsha Blackburn said their bill is urgently needed in 2026.
